title: LandscapeQuery
description:
The contract between the search engine and the landscape model (BRIEF-2.2-b). This is the single most load-bearing schema in DNA Design Suite: a breaking change here propagates into the epistatic surface, the burden model, the repair operator and the decision-support layer simultaneously, which is precisely the hazard the planning phase exists to avoid.

THREE QUERY SHAPES, because one shape cannot serve both the population loop and the coordinate-ascent loop:
  * `full`        - score a complete sequence. Cost O(L). Used by tier 3 and by final re-ranking.
  * `delta`       - score a sequence expressed as a base digest plus <=k codon substitutions. Cost O(k*W) for decomposable terms. Used by tier 2 accept/reject.
  * `delta_table` - return the exact change in every decomposable term for EVERY synonymous alternative at the listed positions. Cost O(|positions| * |Syn| * W). This is the L1 capability of ADR-0002 and it is what makes coordinate ascent affordable; it is also what the repair operator consumes to avoid degrading the objective.

A provider that only implements `full` is legal (capability L0). The search engine degrades to rescoring, which is correct but ~10^3x slower on tier 2; see ADR-0002 for the measured cost model.

cistron_id.description: Which cistron of the construct context this sequence occupies. Required for multi-cistron constructs so the burden ledger can attribute demand.

base_digest.description: Digest of the CodonSequence DOCUMENT the provider has already seen in this session — over the document, so two sequences with identical coding regions but different flanks are distinct cache entries, which they must be because flanks change every structure term. If the cache has evicted it, the provider returns status=`error` with code CF-LAND-010 and the caller resends a `full` query.

edits.description: Substitutions applied to the base. Providers MUST reject an edit whose codon is not synonymous with the base codon at that index (code CF-SEQ-004) - this is where invariant I3 is defended at the contract level rather than by convention.

positions.description: Codon indices to expand. Omitting a position from this list is how the caller excludes locked codons.

host_context.description: Which host, in which physiological state. Separated from construct context because one construct may be scored against several hosts in a portability analysis.

host_profile_digest.description: Pins the exact HostProfile document. Required for reproducibility: tRNA tables get corrected over time.

construct_context.description: The construct the sequence sits in. Inline for one-shot library use, by digest for job execution (the orchestrator uploads it once).

requested_terms.description: Explicit term list. A wildcard is deliberately NOT supported: a job whose objective set depends on which predictors happen to be installed is not reproducible.

outputs.description: Which output blocks to populate. Requesting less is how tier 1 and tier 2 stay cheap.

per_position.description: Per-codon diagnostic tracks. Cost is O(L) memory per term; only the decision-support layer requests these, once per surviving candidate.

deltas.description: Only meaningful with a delta_table target.

gradients.description: L2 capability. Gradient w.r.t. relaxed codon logits; see ADR-0002 for why this is optional and rarely used.

max_latency_ms.description: Soft deadline. A provider that cannot meet it returns status=`partial` with the terms it did compute rather than blocking - the search engine treats a missing term as `unknown` and defers the candidate to the next generation.

namespace.description: Cache partition. Defaults to the landscape lockfile digest, which makes cross-job contamination between different model versions structurally impossible.

model_pins.description: Optional per-term artifact pin, the highest rung of the ADR-0009 resolution ladder. The orchestrator populates this from the job's landscape lockfile so that every query in a job resolves identically even if a channel moves mid-job.

seed.description: RNG stream seed for stochastic predictors (MC dropout, sampled ensembles). Required whenever `uncertainty` is requested with a sampling method, otherwise results are not replayable.
